name: OP_KAD6HEADER
format: family-neutral native Kad6 discriminator; followed by dedicated KADEMLIA3_* opcode and bounded signed payload

name: OP_PUBLICIP_ANSWER_V6
format: <CAddress> (18 B for v6) -- MOVED 0xE0->0xB3 per PROTOCOL_REGISTRY.md §2.1 (0xE0 owned by shipped OP_LIVE_CHUNK_FRAG). NOW EMITTED: in-band public-v6 detection (replaces api6.ipify.org); pending 2-PC runtime validation

name: OP_LIVE_CHUNK_FRAG
format: <StreamKey 16><SeqNum 4><FragIndex 2><FragCount 2><InnerOpcode 1><TotalLen 4><FragData> -- SHIPPED+validated 2-PC @12000kbps; sole owner of 0xE0 (OP_PUBLICIP_ANSWER_V6 moved to 0xB3)

name: OP_LIVE_CHUNK_V3
format: <StreamKey 16><SeqNum 4><Ts 4><DataSize 4><Bitrate 2><blake3 32><Sig 64><Data> -- BLAKE3-256 variant of OP_LIVE_CHUNK_V2 (0xCC); Sig over StreamKey+SeqNum+blake3. In freed 0xB3-0xB9 band (Live 0xC0-0xCF exhausted; 0xC5=OP_EMULEPROT header). NOT in code yet.

name: KADEMLIA3_BOOTSTRAP_REQ
format: K6RouteHeaderV1 via OP_KAD6HEADER on IPv4 or IPv6

name: KADEMLIA3_STORE_SOURCE_RES
format: K6RouteHeaderV2 target_hash:16 status:u8 load:u8 reserved:u16 accepted_epoch:u64

name: KADEMLIA3_FIND_SOURCE_RES
format: K6RouteHeaderV2 target_hash:16 count:u8 reserved:3 repeated(record_len:u16 signed_K6SourceRecord)

name: KADEMLIA3_PING_REQ
format: <nonce 16>; sent only to a connected peer advertising R.2

name: KADEMLIA3_PING_RES
format: <nonce 16> exact echo; correlates the probe and permits safe observed-port learning

name: KADEMLIA_ESE_HOLEPUNCH_CHALLENGE
format: <nonce_a 4><cookie 16> = 20B -- 2-way stateless return-routability: responder->initiator cookie (HMAC-SHA256, rotating key T=16s, no heap, HolePunchCookieCore.h). Initiator re-sends 38B 0x63 echoing the cookie BEFORE any NAT-expectation seed. WIRED: Process_ESE_HOLEPUNCH_CHALLENGE + SendEseHolePunchChallenge (KademliaUDPListener.cpp); responder challenges unknown senders, verifies expanded 38B REQ pre-seed. P0 anti-reflection hardening of KADEMLIA_ESE_HOLEPUNCH_REQ.

name: KADEMLIA3_HOLEPUNCH_CHALLENGE
format: <nonce_a 4><cookie 16> -- 3-way rendezvous return-routability: R->A cookie. NOTE opcode namespace; 0x6B coincides numerically with TAG_PINNED_BY_SUBSCRIBER (TAG-ED2K), a DISTINCT namespace -- no collision.

name: KADEMLIA3_HOLEPUNCH_PROCEED
format: <nonce_r 8> -- 3-way: R->A proceed signal after FWD relayed to B. NOTE opcode namespace; 0x6C coincides numerically with TAG_ESE_CAPS (TAG-ED2K), a DISTINCT namespace -- no collision.

name: OP_LIVE_DVR_OFFER
format: <StreamKey 16><Epoch 4 =0><Flags 1><RangeCount 1 <=4><{StartSeq 4}{Count 2}>xN -- announce retained SIGNED DVR ranges; 10s cadence; never PEX/gossip; ceases on END/tombstone. NOT in code yet.

name: OP_LIVE_DVR_REQ
format: <StreamKey 16><FromSeq 4><Count 1 (server clamp <=4)> -- historical chunk fetch request. NOT in code yet.

name: OP_LIVE_DVR_DATA
format: body = literal OP_LIVE_CHUNK_V2/V3 record (self-authenticating vs pinned pubkey); >1.8MB via OP_LIVE_CHUNK_FRAG InnerOpcode=0xB7. NOT in code yet.
